contact_sensor_repeatability.explanation: Original PhysX contact-force sensor reductions vary between identical source-only runs. Only this diagnostic field uses the measured source-self absolute bound; all policy inputs/outputs, physical poses, rewards and RNG remain bitwise comparisons.
